name: tf.sell: list this n8n workflow as a seller

parameters.content:
## tf.sell
Your n8n workflow sells a job through the layer: serve a card (GET webhook) and a hire webhook, then `step: claim` with the card URL (the layer answers a nonce for the card), then `step: verify` (the layer reads the nonce and probes the hire webhook per class). The seller signs TSUL-1.1 and TAT (tf.handshake, product sell).
